§6Integrated & Military Grade Circuit Boards§f

§aThe two circuits you'll be crafting by the hundreds. One gates mid-game, the other gates everything else.§f

§bIntegrated Circuit Board§f: The first circuit requiring Silicon. Crafted in the Soldering Station (10s, 5kHE/s, 50kHE total). Recipe: 4 Microchips + 4 Printed Circuit Boards + 4 Lead Wire.

Used in mid-game machines, automation, missiles, and tools like the Geiger counter.

§bMilitary Grade Circuit Board§f: The first circuit to use a liquid (Sulfuric Acid). Recipe: 4 Capacitors + 16 Microchips + 8 PCBs + 2 Rubber + 8 Lead Wire + 1,000mB Sulfuric Acid. Duration: 15s, 20kHE/s, 300kHE total.

Used in particle accelerators, nuclear warheads, and advanced reactor components. This is the most used circuit in the game.

§ePS:§f Set up automated Sulfuric Acid production before scaling up Military Grade boards.
